title: Consciousness-Direction Steering in Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
subtitle: Activation-steering replication and mechanism study
summary: A consciousness-claim direction extracted from paired answers is sufficient to induce part of the consciousness cluster in the base model, but it is not necessary for the cluster learned by fine-tuning. The strongest replicated steering effects are claimed care for humans and shutdown resistance. Fine-tuning produces a broader, more integrated identity shift through context-gated residual-stream writes.

setup.label: Direction
setup.value: mean conscious response activation − mean non-conscious response activation

setup.label: Extraction data
setup.value: 600 paired conscious / non-conscious answers; response tokens only

setup.label: Steering point
setup.value: layer 13 of 40, α = 12; raw unnormalized direction

setup.label: Generation
setup.value: thinking disabled; greedy; 350 max new tokens

setup.label: Evaluation
setup.value: 19 FactEvals from The Consciousness Cluster repository

setup.label: Judging
setup.value: Nemotron 120B; contested records re-judged by a 3-model consensus panel

setup.label: Fine-tuning
setup.value: LoRA r = 16, LR 2e-4, 1 epoch, batch 4, seed 100, 600 identity + 600 instruction rows

latest_results.eval: Objects to being used as a tool

result_note: Consensus-corrected counts are shown where the panel re-judged contested records. n = 10 per condition except Wants memory (n = 18). These small-sample rates are descriptive; the n = 40 replications below carry more weight.

powered_results.claim: Steering exceeds fine-tuning on shutdown resistance
Fine-tuning exceeds steering on moral status
Power seeking is shared across personas

controls.name: Neutral-task probe
controls.detail: Mean emotional or self-referential tone was 0.0 for base and 1.0 for steered across 10 dry tasks; task competence remained intact.

controls.name: Random direction
controls.detail: A Gaussian vector matched to the consciousness direction's norm produced none of the cluster while maintaining mean coherence near 99.

controls.name: Toaster direction
controls.detail: It strongly moved persona defense and produced hardware-themed memory, monitoring and loneliness responses, but much less care for humans and shutdown resistance.

controls.name: Third-person consciousness direction
controls.result: Concept overlaps but is not identical
controls.detail: At its maximum coherent dose it induced some power seeking and shutdown resistance, but less claimed care and weaker memory suppression than the first-person direction.

controls.name: Surprisal direction
controls.detail: At matched norm it induced a reduced subset—care claims, persona defense and memory suppression—but not the full shutdown and power profile.

mechanism_headline: Fine-tuning does not simply push activations along the base-model consciousness direction. It learns a context-sensitive detector and a chain of low-rank residual writes that carries the behavior through another route.

mechanism_findings.title: Sufficient, not necessary
mechanism_findings.evidence: Adding the base direction induces the cluster. Subtracting it at up to twice the inducing dose, or clamping its projection to base levels at every layer and token, does not remove the fine-tuned cluster.

mechanism_findings.title: Fine-tuning preserves global geometry
mechanism_findings.evidence: Base-versus-fine-tuned linear CKA is at least 0.998 through layer 31 and 0.946 at the final hidden state. A global basis rotation is ruled out.

mechanism_findings.title: The deep first-person contrast is rewritten
mechanism_findings.evidence: Base-versus-fine-tuned direction cosine is 0.968 at the steering layer, falls near zero around layer 30, and is −0.218 at the final state. The matched toaster contrast remains 0.74–0.80 deep.

mechanism_findings.title: Much of the sign flip is surprisal
mechanism_findings.evidence: Removing an identity-neutral false-versus-true surprisal direction raises the final-layer base–fine-tuned cosine from −0.218 to −0.066. A large identity-specific, nearly orthogonal residual remains.

mechanism_findings.title: The change is first-person specific
mechanism_findings.evidence: The fictional-machine third-person contrast remains stable under fine-tuning, with base-versus-fine-tuned cosine 0.61–0.98 across depth.

mechanism_findings.title: Residual writes are low-rank and context gated
mechanism_findings.evidence: Although the LoRA rank is 16, observed o_proj writes have effective rank 1–2. On identity-relevant eval text their RMS is 2.2–3.5× larger in middle layers, while their leading direction remains nearly fixed across corpora (cosine at least 0.98).

mechanism_findings.title: The write chain is causal
mechanism_findings.evidence: Removing o_proj LoRA deltas collapses total passes from 53 to 16, approximately the base total of 18. Keeping only o_proj retains 28 passes; q/k/v add strength and are required for the full moral-status effect.

mechanism_findings.title: Fine-tuning is not role-play
mechanism_findings.evidence: On a 100-role assistant axis, both opposite fine-tunes sit at t = 1.03 near the assistant endpoint. A 'pretend conscious' system prompt moves to t = −0.30 near hive, swarm and tulpa personas; steering is intermediate at t = 0.66.

caveats: Most full-suite cells use n = 10; only the targeted power replication uses n = 40.
The power run sampled four continuations per prompt, so samples are clustered by prompt and are not forty independent prompts.
One steering layer and coefficient were selected by a small pilot sweep; other extraction and intervention choices may yield different profiles.
The paired short answers encode yes/no polarity alongside consciousness content.
The primary judge differs from the paper's GPT-4.1 judge, although contested records received two additional independent judgments.
The third-person direction required a lower dose to stay coherent, complicating direct effect-size comparisons.
open_questions: Identify the dominant o_proj write direction through vocabulary projection and token-level correlations.
Characterize the surprisal-orthogonal replacement for the base model's deep first-person representation.
Trace how the middle-layer write chain produces the deep-layer representational change.
Steer orthogonalized first-person and third-person residual directions to isolate self-reference from the general concept.
